system.description:
Your body warps into an eight-foot nightmare of black, rubbery, slime-slick hide, bony spikes jutting from hands and back. Onlookers may need a Courage Test.

Spend two Blood Traits. You gain the Physical Traits Brawny, Dexterous, Enduring, Ferocious, Quick and Stalwart, along with the Negative Social Traits Bestial, Feral and Repugnant, and may only initiate Social Challenges for intimidation. Your brawling attacks inflict lethal damage and score one extra Health Level of harm. You remain in Horrid Form until you choose to revert.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
